relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: won a scholarship to Christ's College, Cambridge. Here he became interested in Sanskrit as a result of specialising in comparative philology.

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: was an Indologist and the Boden Professor of Sanskrit at the University of Oxford from 1944 to 1976

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: he was also a fellow of Balliol College, Oxford during this time.

relations.subject: Richard Gombrich
relations.evidence: His professional colleagues during this time included especially Richard Gombrich, Lecturer in Sanskrit from 1965

relations.subject: Richard Gombrich
relations.evidence: Richard Gombrich, Lecturer in Sanskrit from 1965, who would succeed him in the Boden Chair.

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: During the War years, 1937–1944, before his appointment at Oxford, Burrow was Assistant Keeper at the British Museum

relations.subject: Thomas Burrow
relations.evidence: also held an appointment at SOAS from 1938 to 1948.
